title: 第423章 何谓泯灭人性第422章 灭绝人性方为邪魔
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第423章：何谓泯灭人性？
夜色沉沉地压下来，
邪魔大世界的夜空没有星月，
只有翻涌的暗红邪云，
把整座仇劫领地都浸在一片压抑的血色里。
偏殿的烛火跳了跳，
姬豪杰坐在案前，半天没说一句话。
白日里，
蛟龙人弑亲的那一幕，依旧在他脑海里挥之不去。
“姬浩，你说……
人要走到哪一步，
才算真的不是人了？”
他忽然开口，
声音压得很低，显得有些沉重。
姬浩立在一旁，顺着话头接道：“少主是说今日蛟九之事？”
“不止。”
姬豪杰抬眼望向殿外黑沉沉的方向，
那里是仇劫心中的禁地：小黑屋。
“那日我用破界符硬闯结界，
虽被反噬震了回来，

却也瞥见了里面一眼……
最正中的供桌上，
摆着一副人形枯骨。”
姬浩眉峰微不可察地一动。
“下人都说那是供奉邪魔始祖的地方，
可邪魔始祖的遗骸，
怎会是人形？”
姬豪杰扯了扯嘴角，语气里带着几分自嘲，
“现在想来，
他们也没全说错。
确实是‘始祖’，只不过不是邪魔的，而是仇劫为人时的先祖。”
姬浩闻言一愣，
顿了顿，
声音压得更低：
“何止是先祖，我看，那根本就是他爹！”
content_en:
Chapter 423: What does it mean to destroy humanity?
The night falls heavily,
There are no stars or moon in the night sky of the evil world,
Only the surging dark red evil clouds,
The entire Qiujie territory was soaked in oppressive blood.
The candlelight in the side hall danced,
Ji Haojie sat in front of the case and didn't say a word for a long time.
During the day,
The scene of the Jiaolong people's parricide still lingered in his mind.
"Ji Hao, you said...
Where will a person go?
Are you really not a human being anymore? "
He suddenly spoke,
The voice was very low and seemed a bit heavy.
Ji Hao stood aside and followed the words: "Young Master, are you talking about today's incident of Jiao Jiu?"
"More than that."
Ji Haojie raised his eyes and looked in the dark direction outside the hall.
That was the forbidden place in Qiu Jie's heart: the little dark room.
"That day I used the boundary-breaking talisman to break through the barrier.
Although he was shaken back by the backlash,
But I also got a glimpse inside...
On the altar table in the center,
There is a set of human bones. "
Ji Hao's eyebrows moved imperceptibly.
"My servants all say that it is the place where the ancestor of evil spirits is worshipped.
But the remains of the evil ancestor,
How could it be humanoid? "
Ji Haojie twitched the corners of his lips, with a bit of self-deprecation in his tone.
"Now that I think about it,
They weren't entirely wrong either.
He was indeed the ‘ancestor’, but not from the demon, but from Qiu Jie’s human ancestor. "
Ji Hao was stunned when he heard this.
After a pause,
The voice is lowered:
"Not only is he an ancestor, I think he is actually his father!"
